entities.name: tRNA-splicing endonuclease
observations: The 182-aa query exactly matches reviewed Saccharolobus islandicus tRNA-splicing endonuclease reference sequences (100% identity and coverage; E-value 2.61e-127).
Annotated function: cleaves pre-tRNA at both splice sites to release the intron; product termini include 2′,3′-cyclic phosphate and 5′-OH.
Pfam domains: tRNA_int_endo_N (PF02778.20; residues 2–79) and tRNA_int_endo (PF01974.24; residues 89–170).
Reference annotation reports a homotetramer, cytoplasmic localization, and tRNA intron lyase activity (EC 4.6.1.16).
Sequence-derived estimates: 20,798 Da molecular mass; pI 9.27; instability index 16.09; GRAVY −0.040.
